Sandbox_DelRoads_RepairLastsDays_tooltip: After about this many game days (give or take a quarter) a mended tile cracks again.
Sandbox_DelRoads_RequireOrder_tooltip: On: staff mend only inside a work order their City Hall has accepted. Off: any road, orders are paid contracts on top. Admins are never limited.
Sandbox_DelRoads_RepairTime_tooltip: Length of the timed action, in action ticks (vanilla plastering a wall is 100).
Sandbox_DelRoads_TyreWear_tooltip: On: driving over cracked asphalt faster than 20 km/h now and then takes a condition point off a tyre. Mended tiles do not.
Sandbox_DelRoads_TyreWearRate_tooltip: 1 = about 3 condition points a minute at 60 km/h on cracked road (spread over the tyres), faster driving wears more. 0 switches it off.
